questions.questionText:
A natural resource was discovered in a country. The exploitation of this resource allowed the
country to double its gross domestic product within ten years.
Why did this not solve the basic economic problem?

options.text: Exploiting the resource required high expenditure on capital equipment.
Exploiting the resource caused significant environmental damage.
Gross domestic product was unevenly distributed in the country.
Wants still exceeded the resources available to meet those wants.

What is the opportunity cost of growing the potatoes?

options.text: the time spent preparing the potato field

options.text: allowing governments to provide price stability
preventing competitors from entering a market

Which combination of ownership and sector is this?
ownership sector
What is not included in public expenditure?

questions.questionText: When is the budget described as balanced?

options.text: when direct taxes and indirect taxes are equal
when exports and imports are equal
when government spending and government revenue are equal
when the demand for money and the supply of money are equal

questions.questionText: What is the main aim of supply-side policy?

options.text: increasing economic growth by raising productivity
increasing the balance of payments surplus by restricting free trade
reducing the government’s budget deficit by increasing taxation
reducing the money supply by increasing the rate of interest

questions.questionText:
A country has full employment.
Which policy is most likely to lead to a fall in economic growth in the short run but an increase in
economic growth in the long run?

options.text: restricting the immigration of key workers
selling assets owned in other countries

questions.questionText:
A government has a contractionary fiscal policy to reduce inflation. What will the government
increase?
What would not be required in the construction of an index of consumer prices?

options.text: the selection of a base year
the selection of a representative range of items
the calculation of average wage levels
the weighting of each item in the index

country?

questions.questionText:

account of the balance of payments.

options.text: an increase in its foreign currency reserves
an increase in the demand for its currency on the foreign exchange market
an increase in the supply of its currency on the foreign exchange market
